newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CS First Boston boosts biotechs.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CS First Boston boosts biotechs.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Jeffrey Swarz said he boosted the recommended portfolio weighting of the biotech group to overweight from neutral.
-- Cited potential benefit to the group from a capital gains tax cut proposed in the balanced budget deal.
-- "A potential capital gains decrease would favor stocks with high capital appreciation potential versus stocks with dividends," he said.
-- Noted biotech sector has been lagging S&P 500 over past three quarters.
-- Said among large-capitalization biotech companies, was recommending Amgen Inc, Biogen Inc, Centocor Inc and Genzyme Corp.
-- Among small caps, listed Affymetrix Inc, Human Genome Sciences Inc, BioChem Pharma Inc, Cell Genesys Inc.
